sql: WITH actuals AS (SELECT ProductCategoryKey, sum(Amount) as actual FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan WHERE ScenarioKey = 1 AND DateKey >= '2009-10-01' AND DateKey <= '2009-12-31' AND AccountKey = 4 GROUP BY ProductCategoryKey), forecasts AS (SELECT ProductCategoryKey, sum(Amount) as forecast FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan WHERE ScenarioKey = 3 AND DateKey >= '2009-10-01' AND DateKey <= '2009-12-31' AND AccountKey = 4 GROUP BY ProductCategoryKey) SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName, a.actual, f.forecast, round(abs(a.actual - f.forecast) * 100.0 / nullIf(a.actual, 0), 2) as error_pct FROM actuals a JOIN forecasts f ON a.ProductCategoryKey = f.ProductCategoryKey JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON a.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
